say:2:1013218002:1.text: Marilee told me you're an incredibly powerful magister, and I even got to see your magic in action!
say:2:1013218002:1.source_cn: 梅瑞特刚刚跟我说您是超级厉害的魔法师，我居然就有幸亲眼...
say:2:1013218002:1.male: Marilee told me you're an incredibly powerful magister, and I even got to see your magic in action!
say:2:1013218002:1.female: Marilee told me you're an incredibly powerful magister, and I even got to see your magic in action!

say:4:1013218003:1.text: Miss Fay, you've got quite an eye! He's the most powerful magister in the world!
say:4:1013218003:1.source_cn: 菲小姐，你很有眼光！主人是这个世界上最厉害的魔法师！
say:4:1013218003:1.male: Miss Fay, you've got quite an eye! He's the most powerful magister in the world!
say:4:1013218003:1.female: Miss Fay, you've got quite an eye! She's the most powerful magister in the world!

say:5:1013218004:1.text: Yep! You can effortlessly pinpoint the source of an aura using simple spells!
say:5:1013218004:1.source_cn: 没错！您用简简单单的术式就能锁定气息的源头，真了不起！
say:5:1013218004:1.male: Yep! You can effortlessly pinpoint the source of an aura using simple spells!
say:5:1013218004:1.female: Yep! You can effortlessly pinpoint the source of an aura using simple spells!

say:6:1013218005:1.text: I would have passed the Lyceum exam if I had met you earlier.
say:6:1013218005:1.source_cn: 要是能早早遇见您，我一定就能通过莱希拉姆的考试了。
say:6:1013218005:1.male: I would have passed the Lyceum exam if I had met you earlier.
say:6:1013218005:1.female: I would have passed the Lyceum exam if I had met you earlier.

say:8:1013218006:2.text: Your gemstone research is impressive, yet you haven't become a qualified magister yet?
say:8:1013218006:2.source_cn: 你的宝石研究做得还不错，原来还没有取得魔法师的资格吗？

say:9:1013218007:2.text: Ah, I'm not that talented. And those spells and incantations... I really have no idea how to get them into my head.
say:9:1013218007:2.source_cn: 唉，我的天赋不是很强。而且那些术式和咒语……我是真不知...

say:10:1013218008:1.text: I've taken the test three times, and my score has been lower each time...
say:10:1013218008:1.source_cn: 我考了三次，分数一次比一次低……

say:14:1013218010:2.text: I'm sorry, Miss, but the magister is needed for a moment.
say:14:1013218010:2.source_cn: 不好意思，可爱的小姐，你的老师先借我用一下。
say:14:1013218010:2.male: I'm sorry, Miss, but the magister is needed for a moment.
say:14:1013218010:2.female: I'm sorry, Miss, but the magister is needed for a moment.
